👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, Israel duniya ke sabse powerful countries mein se ek maana jaata hai. Is desh ki sabse mind-blowing baat yeh hai ki pichhle 50 saalon mein Israel ne 6 wars lade hain. Kai baar 5 deshon ne ek saath is par hamla kiya, chaaron taraf se terrorist attacks jhele, aur bade-bade deshon ne ise boycott bhi kiya. Yahan tak ki Iran ke leaders ne khule aam bayan diya ki woh Israel ka naam-o-nishan mita denge.
Phir bhi Israel ke paas na China jaisi badi army hai, na India jaisi massive labour force. Geographically dekha jaaye toh na Saudi Arabia jaise tel ke kuaan, na koi khaas natural resources. 1948 mein paani ki itni kami thi ki Israeli government ne per person sirf 10 litre paani ki limit laga di thi.1948 mein agar koi Israel ko dekhta, toh shayad kehta ki yeh desh agar Africa ke kisi gareeb desh ki tarah sirf survive bhi kar jaaye, toh bhi bahut badi baat hogi. Lekin aaj wahi Israel duniya ke sabse powerful deshon mein shumar hota hai.
Toh sawaal yeh hai — bina paani, labour, natural resources aur oil ke, itna chhota sa desh duniya ki top powers mein kaise shamil hua? Kaunsi strategy thi jisne war ke beech bhi Israel ko ek “Startup Nation” bana diya? Aur sabse important — India ko Israel ke rise se kya seekhna chahiye?
